name: Shia Kids TV
description: Dedicated Shia children's video channel with animations, Ahlul Bayt stories, nasheeds, duas and child-friendly learning.

name: Shia Kids TV — Imam Mahdi / Nasheeds
description: Start with Imam Mahdi-focused children's material, including nasheeds and simple learning videos. Open the channel and choose age-appropriate videos.

name: Shia Kids TV — Quran & Learning
description: Use Shia Kids TV as a starting channel for Quran recitation, memorisation competitions, Quran stories and child-friendly learning videos.

name: Shia Kids TV — Ahlul Bayt Stories
description: A starting collection for child-friendly stories about the Ahlul Bayt, including Imam Ali, Imam Hussain, Imam Hasan al-Askari and other personalities.

name: Shia Kids TV — Direct Channel
description: Direct entry to the full Shia Kids TV channel. Use the age and topic filters on this site before opening YouTube when possible.

name: Hujja Kids — Direct Platform
description: Shia children's entertainment and educational platform with age-appropriate shows, live programs, stories, Quran recitation, quizzes and activities. Its site states that it is scholar approved by Sayed Muthana Alhakeem.

name: Faraj Kids — Direct Channel / Platform
description: Children's Islamic content including puppet shows, animations, storytime and stories from the Prophets, Quran and Ahlul Bayt.

name: Faraj Kids — Jawad & Maahira
description: Child-focused videos and nasheeds designed to make Quran and Ahlulbayt learning engaging. Includes Urdu-dubbed material such as Imam Hussain and Karbala stories.

name: Sayed Ali Alhakeem / Hussaini Kid — Youth & Kids
description: English recitations and youth-oriented Shia material associated with Sayed Ali Alhakeem. Suitable items should be selected by age/topic rather than treating the entire channel as children's content.

name: Pearls of Light — Ahlul Bayt Animated Stories
description: Animated Ahlul Bayt and moral stories. Treat as a community source and evaluate individual episodes before broad recommendation.

name: Wilayat Ki Rail — Shia Kids TV
description: Urdu children's nasheed/video introducing Wilayat in a lively child-oriented format.

name: Isra wal Miraj — Bachon ke liye Islami Kahani
description: Urdu child-friendly animated story of Isra wal Miraj with an age-friendly explanation and Salah focus.

name: Isra wal Miraj for Kids — Shia Animation
description: English child-friendly animated presentation of Isra wal Miraj from a Shia perspective.

name: Arbaeen: A Lesson for Life — Children's Animated Movie
description: Islamic animated movie for children and families about Arbaeen through love, sacrifice, unity and service.

name: Nuh Ki Kashti — Animated Quran Story
description: Child-friendly animated telling of the Quranic story of Prophet Nuh (AS).

name: Alwasi TV — Children's Shows
description: Shia media platform offering children's shows alongside Quran, educational and cultural content.
